title: Using Dexamethasone After Uvulopalatopharyngoplasty
brief_summary: This study looks at lessening the pain after a Uvulopalatopharyngoplasty (UPPP) surgery by using Dexamethasone (a corticosteroid).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Candidates scheduled for UPPP surgery.
* Able to take steroids

Exclusion Criteria:

* Those patients who unable to take steroids
